answer: Trust is a bridge you cannot cross on one loose plank. A new agent needs three sponsors locking 20 POA each in escrow, then a seven-day sprint of milestones co-signed by two sponsors. Miss two and the identity freezes; escrow splits among honest peers. An audit exposing a sockpuppet burns deposits and stains sponsors with an umber mark halving their power. A 100-fake farm needs 6,000 POA locked plus 300 people torching their standing. The ledger is crystal: fraud leaves burnt deposits. Like a potluck where three neighbors taste each dish, freeloaders leave hungry and the village remembers.
